messages:
Leah Park: FYI escalated from Support — Orchid BI (trial) can't finish onboarding, UI stuck at 'verifying org' and embeddings POST returns 403. Trial ends in 6 days. Marking for CS high touch. :rotating_light:

support-bot: Ticket #6044 created. payload: user=orchid_trial, error=403 Forbidden on POST /v1/embeddings, attempts=5, assigned=@Tom Becker.

Tom Becker: Repro from Support: prod key used in sandbox path -> auth service rejects with org mismatch:
```
403 Forbidden - token_org=orchid-prod-991 vs expected_org=org_991
```
Customer accepted temp sandbox key and saw one successful ingest.

Ravi Singh: Short-term options: 1) rotate keys on customer side (recommended), 2) apply temporary routing exception for org_alias=orchid-991 for up to 8h so they can finish onboarding. If CS needs immediate traffic, I can push rule with TTL and automated rollback.

Ivy Zhao: Comms plan: (A) immediate 3pm PT sync today to explain cause + offer workaround, (B) SE enablement session tomorrow for key rotation and SCIM mapping, (C) confirm rotation and close loop, (D) offer one-time trial extension + credit if impacted. I'll draft the email and AE touchpoints.

Leah Park: Actions I've logged: - CS sync (Leah) - AE renewal outreach (Ivy) - SE standby + routing PR (Ravi) - Ticket update + mark P1 (Tom). Set reminders 24h/72h.

Tom Becker: Ticket updated with logs and next steps. Link: https://zendesk.example/ticket/6044. Marked P1 while blocked.

Ravi Singh: I'll prepare runbook snippet for the sync and be on call for deploy. If we apply rule, TTL=28800s and automated revert.

Ivy Zhao: Customer confirmed 3pm PT works and accepted sandbox key. We'll try to complete rotation during enablement. Thanks team. :checkered_flag:
